description: Runs a build command and returns structured success/failure with errors and warnings. Allowed commands: ant, bazel, bun, bunx, cargo, cmake, dotnet, esbuild, go, gradle, gradlew, make, msbuild, mvn, npm, npx, nx, pnpm, rollup, tsc, turbo, vite, webpack, yarn.

env.description: Environment variables to set for the build process (e.g., { NODE_ENV: 'production', CI: 'true' }). Merged with existing environment.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds (default: 300000, max: 600000). Use for builds that need more or less time.

name: build
title: Run Build
